process.title: How it works
process.subtitle: From design to delivery in four steps

steps.title: Send your design
steps.body: Send us your logo, artwork, or design concept. We accept AI, EPS, PNG, JPG, and more.

steps.title: Choose your products
steps.body: Select from our range of shirts, hoodies, and hats. Pick colors, sizes, and quantities.

steps.title: We print and check it
steps.body: We print your order and check its quality before it leaves the shop.

steps.title: Ready in 24–48 hours
steps.body: Your custom order is ready in 24–48 hours, with same-day rush available.

sizes.title: Size charts
sizes.note: Need a size that isn’t listed? Ask us: custom sizing is available for special orders.
